title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Counting Fun!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends explore the world of numbers! Bella has a fun idea to help everyone learn to count while playing a game. Together, they discover that counting can be exciting and useful!
lesson: Kids learn to count from 1 to 10 and understand the value of numbers.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, Marjona, and Twinkle meet in the sunny garden. They remember their fun adventures together, especially learning about colors and shapes. Baby Leo excitedly says, 'What can we learn today?'
Bella hops in and says, 'Let’s learn to count! Counting is fun!' She brings out colorful flowers to count. The friends cheer in excitement.
They gather the flowers. Baby Leo holds one flower and says, 'This is one!' The friends giggle and join him.
Bobo counts the flowers with his strong bear voice, 'One, two, three!' Everyone claps and cheers for Bobo.
Marjona jumps in with a bright smile and says, 'Let’s count the butterflies too!' The friends spread out to find butterflies.
Twinkle flies up high and calls out, 'I see four butterflies!' The others rush to see. They all count together, 'One, two, three, four!'
As they play, they come across a pile of leaves. Bella suggests, 'Let’s count them too!' They laugh and start counting the leaves.
At the end, they count all the things they found: flowers, butterflies, and leaves. They shout, 'Wow! We counted so much!'
Baby Leo says, 'Learning to count is super fun! Thank you, Bella!' They all smile and cheer together.
The episode ends with the friends playing a counting game, happily celebrating their new counting skills.
